notes: Incidence of suicidal deaths in States, Union Territories and cities.

The regional distribution of incidence of suicides shows marked variation from State to State. Table 9 presents actual incidence of such deaths in different States, Union Territories and cities during 1966 and 1967. This Table also indicates percentage variation from 1966 to 1967. A maximum increase of 118.26% has been recorded by Punjab, while Madhya Pradesh indicated significant decline of 27.3%. Among the Union Territories Pondicherry and Tripura reported decline of 9.6% and 37.7% respectively but Delhi indicated a marked increase of 84.3%. Bangalore city recorded a sharp decline of 60.5% while Delhi city showed a significant increase of 65.1%.
